questions.question: Which term refers to the strategy of optimizing an algorithm's use of resources, often by making sacrifices in one aspect for improvements in another?
questions.explanation: A tradeoff is the deliberate sacrifice of one resource (e.g. memory) to improve another (e.g. time). Greedy, divide and conquer and dynamic programming are design paradigms, not this strategy.

questions.question: Objects are
questions.explanation: An object is an instance of a class: the class is the blueprint and objects are its concrete instances.

questions.question: Which of the following networking devices is used to regenerate and transmit the weakened signal ahead?
questions.explanation: A repeater works at the physical layer and regenerates a weakened signal so it can travel further. A hub broadcasts to all ports, and a modem converts between digital and analog signals.

questions.question: In an AVL tree, the balance factor of a node is the difference between the heights of its:
questions.explanation: In an AVL tree, balance factor = height(left subtree) - height(right subtree), and it must be -1, 0 or 1. It is about subtree heights, not just the immediate children.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a step in the Header translation procedure?

options.A: The IPv6 mapped address is changed to an IPv4 address by extracting the rightmost 32 bits
options.B: The value of the IPv6 priority field is discarded
options.C: The IPv6 flow label is considered
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In header translation from IPv6 to IPv4, the mapped address yields the IPv4 address from its rightmost 32 bits and the priority field is discarded; the flow label is ignored, not considered.

questions.question: What is the difference between a website and a web page?

options.A: A website is a collection of web pages, while a web page is a single document that is displayed on the web.
options.B: A website is a software program, while a web page is a hardware device.
options.C: A website is a physical object, while a web page is a logical object.

questions.explanation: A website is a collection of related web pages under a domain, while a web page is a single document displayed in a browser. The other statements are false, so 'All of the above' is wrong.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.question: Which of the following is a database?
questions.explanation: MySQL, IBM Informix and Microsoft SQL Server are all relational database management systems.

questions.question: How does the DOM tree structure reflect the hierarchy of HTML elements?
questions.explanation: The DOM represents nested HTML elements as a tree of parent, child and sibling nodes. Order, size and colour play no role.

questions.question: What does the term "harvard architecture" refer to in the context of microcontrollers?

options.A: A type of microcontroller with high processing speed
options.B: A microcontroller architecture that uses a separate memory space for instructions and data
options.C: A microcontroller with advanced addressing modes
options.D: A microcontroller with a large number of I/O ports

questions.explanation: Harvard architecture uses separate memories and buses for instructions and data, allowing simultaneous fetches. Von Neumann architecture shares one memory for both.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a valid variable name in most programming languages?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Identifiers cannot begin with a digit, so 123Variable is invalid. Names starting with a letter or underscore, like myVariable and _myVariable, are valid.

questions.question: Church's Thesis supports ________.

options.A: Both: TM is a general-purpose computer, and TM is an algorithm and vice versa
options.B: A Turing machine as an algorithm and an algorithm as a Turing machine
options.C: A Turing machine as a general-purpose computer system

questions.explanation: Church's thesis states that any algorithm can be carried out by a Turing machine and vice versa, so a TM models both a general-purpose computer and an algorithm. Options B and C each state only one part.

questions.question: The I/O subsystem in an operating system is responsible for:

options.C: Managing input/output operations between processes and input/output devices

questions.explanation: The I/O subsystem manages I/O between processes and devices through device drivers, buffering, caching and scheduling. Memory allocation and CPU scheduling are other OS modules.

questions.question: Let the word be "automata". The total number of states required to recognize the word using DFA would be __________

options.D: word cannot be recognized using DFA

questions.explanation: 'automata' has 8 characters, so a DFA recognizing it needs a start state plus one state per character: 9 states (excluding a dead state). 8 states forgets the start state.

questions.question: What will happen if in a C++ program, a class has no name?

options.A: It is not even allowed in C++
options.B: It will not have the constructor
options.C: It will not have the destructor
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: An unnamed (anonymous) class is allowed in C++, but since constructors and destructors must carry the class name, it cannot have a user-defined constructor or destructor. Both B and C are true.

questions.question: Which of the following is done by Secure Sockets Layers?

options.A: creates a secure, private connection to a web server

questions.explanation: SSL establishes a secure, private connection with a web server, encrypts the data and transmits it over the internet, so all statements apply.

questions.question: SQL applies conditions on the groups through _____ clause after groups have been formed.
questions.explanation: HAVING filters groups produced by GROUP BY. WHERE filters individual rows before grouping.

questions.question: Which of the following is not considered as a type of e-waste?
questions.explanation: E-waste is discarded electrical or electronic equipment such as TVs, personal devices, scanners and copiers. A newspaper is paper waste.

questions.question: Who is known as the father of AI?
questions.explanation: John McCarthy coined the term 'Artificial Intelligence' in 1956 and is called the father of AI. Alan Turing is known as the father of computer science.

questions.concept: Decimal to binary, octal and hex
questions.question: Convert the decimal number 1234 to binary, octal, and hexadecimal. Which of the following options correctly represents these conversions?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: 1234 = 1024 + 128 + 64 + 16 + 2 = 10011010010 in binary; grouping by 3 gives octal 2322 and grouping by 4 gives hex 4D2. The other options do not equal 1234.

questions.question: How can you establish a connection between PHP and MySQL?

options.C: By embedding MySQL queries directly in PHP code
options.D: By using the "mysqli_connect()" function in PHP

questions.explanation: In PHP a MySQL connection is opened with mysqli_connect() (or the mysqli/PDO objects). There is no generic connect() function, and queries cannot run without first establishing a connection.

questions.question: The default style for new data keyed in a new workbook is?
questions.explanation: New data in a new workbook uses the Normal style; Comma, Currency and Percent are optional number styles.

questions.question: Communication over mobile phone is an example of which type of communication mode?
questions.explanation: On a mobile phone call both parties can talk and listen at the same time, which is full-duplex. A walkie-talkie is half-duplex.

questions.question: _____ is a two-dimensional data structure in Python with row index and column index.
questions.explanation: A pandas DataFrame is a 2-D labelled structure with a row index and column labels. A Series is one-dimensional.

questions.question: A linear data structure in which insertion and deletion operations can be performed from both the ends is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A deque (double-ended queue) allows insertion and deletion at both front and rear. A normal or circular queue inserts at the rear and deletes from the front only.
